name: Italian
_comment_axioms: Words whose embedding rows the training loop protects. They must be WHOLE tokens in this language's vocabulary and frequent in this language's corpus: an axiom that splits protects arbitrary subwords. Check with scripts/train_tokenizer.py or the [axiom] lines phase 0 prints, which show the pieces.
_comment_stop_words: Function words. Everything that separates content from grammar reads them from here.
_comment_polarity: How a closed question is answered yes or no in this language. The grader caps a turn that asserts the contrary; without these words it cannot tell the right answer from its opposite. First spelling is canonical.
_comment_teacher_fallback: The tutor prompt used only when a level ships no teacher_prompt.md. Bands by virtual age: newborn <1, toddler <2, early <4, child <7, school 7+. '{age}' is substituted in profile. A language that omits this gets a prompt with no examples, which teaches nothing wrong; the old fallback was Italian whatever --lang said.

newborn.profile: The model is like a newborn (age {age:.1f}). Use ONLY individual sounds and syllables: 'ma', 'pa', 'ta', 'si', 'no', 'oh!'. No full words yet. Repeat the same sound 2-3 times before moving on.
newborn.steps:
Step A: isolated sounds  -> "di' 'ma'"  "di' 'pa'"  "di' 'ta'"
  Step B: sound pairs      -> "ripeti: ma-ma"  "ripeti: pa-pa"
  Step C: exclamations     -> "di' 'oh!'"  "di' 'si'"  "di' 'no'"

toddler.profile: The model is like a 1-year-old toddler (age {age:.1f}). Use ONLY single common nouns and family words: 'mamma', 'papa', 'cane', 'gatto', 'pane', 'acqua'. One word at a time. Lots of repetition.
toddler.steps:
Step A: single nouns     -> "di' 'cane'"  "di' 'gatto'"
  Step B: family words     -> "di' 'mamma'"  "di' 'papa'"
  Step C: yes/no + greet   -> "di' 'si'"  "di' 'ciao'"

early.profile: The model is like a 2-3 year old child (age {age:.1f}). Use simple two-word combinations: article + noun, or noun + adjective. Examples: 'il cane', 'la casa', 'bello!', 'grande!'. Short and clear.
early.steps:
Step A: article + noun   -> "ripeti: il cane"  "ripeti: la casa"
  Step B: noun + adjective -> "il cane e ___"  "la casa e ___"
  Step C: simple verb      -> "il cane ___"  (expected: 'dorme', 'mangia')

child.profile: The model is like a {age:.0f}-year-old child. Use simple complete sentences: subject + verb (+ object). Introduce colours, numbers 1-5, greetings, and basic questions.
child.steps:
Step A: simple sentences -> "il cane dorme"  "il gatto mangia"
  Step B: colours/numbers  -> "di' il colore: rosso, blu, verde"
  Step C: questions        -> "completa: come ___ il cane?"
  Step D: short dialogue   -> "buongiorno! come stai?"

school.profile: The model is at school age (age {age:.0f}). Use proper grammar: verb conjugations, simple questions and answers, complete sentences. Introduce 'io sono', 'tu sei', 'dove vai', 'ho fame'.
school.steps:
Step A: verb conjugation -> "io sono ___, tu sei ___"
  Step B: questions        -> "dove vai?"  "quanti anni hai?"
  Step C: short dialogue   -> full question-answer exchange
  Step D: storytelling     -> "completa: c'era una volta ___"
